name: Expert Litter Training Spray for Cats

variants.name: 200 ml
variants.about_this_item: Training spray that teaches kittens and cats to use the litter tray. It attracts the animal by reproducing its own marking, and helps keep the home clean — also useful when moving to a new home or changing the tray.
variants.ingredient_information: Anise and nutmeg oils attract the pet by reproducing its own marking; the "Rintintin" perfume composition has a scent pets find pleasant and draws them to the treated surface.
variants.feeding_instructions: Shake the bottle and spray the product onto a piece of paper. Put the paper where you have decided the toilet should be and draw the pet’s attention to it, ideally after it wakes up or after a meal. Change the paper after each use. Repeat for 10–14 days, until the habit is established. Keep the toilet area clean; never punish the pet physically during the training.
